title: Extracting Captures and Match Data
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of extracting captures and match data in a Ruby program and name the key rule involved.
Apply extracting captures and match data in a small example and predict its result before running it.
Identify one boundary or failure case related to accessing matched values and verify the intended behavior.

content.intro: Learn Extracting Captures and Match Data through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding extracting captures and match data helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Extracting Captures and Match Data helps you reason about numbered captures. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Numbered captures. Then connect it to Named captures. The remaining syllabus points—Accessing matched values—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.
